SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

File No. ______

REPORT

（印：S... Station, Date Sept 18, 1931, S. P. D. 2766, ... 19 - 9 - 31.）

Subject (in full) Zung Pung Jen (陳本仁), a student of the Tung Wen College.

Made by J.D.S. Umemoto. Forwarded by [签名]

In accordance with your instructions, enquiries made in connection with a Chinese student of the Tung Wen College named Zung Mok Jen (陳木仁) show that there is a student by the name of Zung Pung Jen (陳本仁), whose name differs slightly from that of Zung Mok Ven only by an additional stroke in the second character.

Zung Pung Ven (20) is a native of Hunan and entered the College in September 1930. His guarantor is a teacher of the Labour University, Kiangwan.

Some time ago he instigated other Chinese students to refrain from paying the boarding fee on the ground that the College is maintained by the Chinese indemnity to Japan. Since then he has failed to pay the fee.

The College Authorities are carefully watching his activities amongst the Chinese students.

[签名]
J. D. S.

（批：A.R. 19/9）

Officer i/c Special Branch.

报告

（印章：S... 巡捕房，日期 1931年9月18日，S. P. D. 2766，... 19 - 9 - 31。）

事由（全称）同文书院学生陈本仁（Zung Pung Jen）。

由 J.D.S. Umemoto 撰写。由 [签名] 转呈

遵照阁下指示，针对一名名为陈木仁（Zung Mok Jen）的同文书院中国学生进行的查询显示，确有一名名为陈本仁（Zung Pung Jen）的学生，其姓名与陈木仁（Zung Mok Ven）仅有一字之差，即第二个字多了一笔。

陈本仁（20岁）系湖南人，于1930年9月进入该院就读。其保证人为江湾劳动大学的一名教师。

前一段时间，他以该书院由日本对华赔款维持为由，煽动其他中国学生拒付膳宿费。自那以后，他一直未缴纳费用。

书院当局正在密切监视他在中国学生中的活动。

[签名]
J. D. S.

（批注：A.R. 9月19日）

特务科主管警官。

returned herewith.

Confidential

Dear Mr. Robertson:-

Enclosed, herewith, translation of a
Chinese letter, written in secret ink, from
an unknown address in Shanghai, to an
accommodation address of the Communist
Party in Singapore.

The man mentioned, Lau Tong Yok,
whose photograph is attached, is a very
well known militant Communist, who
was banished from Singapore this year on
account of his activities.

I suggest you either make enquiries
concerning the address given, or hand these
pages.zh:

随函附上一封用密写墨水书写的中文信件的译文，

新加坡共产党的一个通讯处。

信中提及的刘通约（Lau Tong Yok），
其照片附后，是一名非常著名的激进共产党员，
今年因其活动被驱逐出新加坡。
